responses.draft_cover_letter:
I have a strong track record of improving system performance, most recently reducing a critical API’s p95 latency from 900 ms to 180 ms through careful query tuning and profiling. That experience taught me how to identify bottlenecks, instrument code, and measure impact—skills directly relevant to building high‑throughput storage components.

While I have not yet worked with Rust, B‑tree or LSM storage engines, or consensus protocols such as Raft or Paxos, I am eager to apply my analytical approach to these areas. I thrive on learning new low‑level technologies and am confident that my proven ability to drive measurable performance gains will translate quickly to the challenges of a distributed SQL database. I look forward to contributing to Lattice Databases’ engineering team and growing alongside its ambitious roadmap.
